observation.coordinate_frame: multipole local frame; axial z and transverse x/y

allowed: engineering stability at the frozen bin resolution

basis.position: The range is bounded by the shared 4 mm radial working scale and exit-interface acceptance geometry.
basis.energy: The range brackets the frozen nominal 2 eV source and all retained no-acceleration reference states.
basis.time: The range brackets all retained no-acceleration reference handoff times under the frozen source and geometry.
basis.angle: The range brackets all retained no-acceleration reference handoff divergence values.
basis.percentage_tolerance: No arbitrary relative percentage is introduced.

claim_limit: This is an internal downstream-resolution contract. It may issue engineering stability at its fixed bin resolution, but it cannot establish absolute physical accuracy, solver equivalence, Candidate, Formal or N=1000 status.
